blocking_findings.description: There is no independent role-access expansion. audit rejects owner='role' immediately, and audit_role_access does not exist. Consequently E5/E6/W2/W3 have declaration strings and callable primitives but no accounting that establishes their required primitive accesses. Both adapter instances of the dedicated acceptance sentinel fail. Deferring role domain semantics to d2 does not defer this child's explicitly assigned declaration/access foundation.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Implement independent role primitive-access obligation expansion and accounting, preserving explicit denial of complete semantic support. Pass the direct and retained role-access controls and add isolated missing, substituted and unconsumed access negatives.

blocking_findings.description: The claimed all-rule inventory is incomplete. COMPUTED is absent, so Evidence digest inputs and TestPlan authored-content operands are not declared as required by the sealed plan and the failing computed-input sentinel. CompetingSet.members also declares only mapping shape, kind and residual description; it does not declare the conditional exact Hypothesis reference for named members. The literal test inventory repeats that omission, so dictionary equality cannot establish complete dependency coverage.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Complete the raw and computed operand inventory against the existing local contracts, including conditional named-member references and computed-input dependencies. Route each input and computed result through the shared boundary and add independent literal controls for valid and damaged dependencies.

blocking_findings.description: prepare validates scope pins and enumerates kinds, then discards the collection results. It neither establishes root membership relative to the checked scope nor records checked active/inactive rule obligations. Receipt has no inactive accounting, and both checked-inactivity sentinel instances fail. The unconditional role-semantics diagnostic prevents a complete clean result, but does not fulfill the planned scope and applicability foundation.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Implement checked root membership and explicit applicability accounting from validated scope, collections and discriminants. Preserve incomplete semantic status while testing valid empty scope, active roots, damaged membership and falsely inactive branches on both adapters.

blocking_findings.description: Expected obligations are a second manually executed recipe, not an exhaustive expansion of declarations. The manifest supplies a contract only after a recipe requests a path; nothing reconciles declared active fields with requested paths. In isolated direct and SQLite-reader probes, adding the same required text field to the manifest and live Evidence declarations, leaving it absent and unread, still produced no diagnostics and successful support. Removing every entry from lint_context.RULES likewise left successful auditing unchanged. Comparing the two execution traces therefore cannot detect all omitted rules or unconsumed declarations.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Establish expected active obligations independently from the complete declarations and checked applicability, then reconcile actual consumption against them. Validate live rule ownership and dependency declarations. Add deletion-sensitive controls for unread declarations, missing rules and substituted occurrence/dependency identities.

blocking_findings.description: Exact event-list equality rejects valid graphs because expansion and preparation traverse collections in different orders. Expansion.media validates each ingestion immediately, whereas the temporal preparer first resolves all candidate media edges. Expansion.observation resolves all evidence edges before preparing evidence, whereas the preparer resolves and prepares each in turn. Independent probes found no baseline diagnostics but an accounting mismatch for two valid ingestions on direct and in-memory SQLite paths, and for two valid observation evidence references on the direct path. Single-member fixtures conceal this defect.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Make accounting preserve dependency association and multiplicity without depending on these incidental traversal-order differences, or align traversal consistently. Add literal multi-ingestion and multi-evidence positive controls, reordered-input controls and missing/extra-occurrence negatives on both adapters.

blocking_findings.description: Focused controls do not cover every newly introduced validator and access branch as sealed. The new role field matrix exercises only Hypothesis.confidence; role edge resolution, exact-history access and prediction-key path handling have no isolated valid/negative controls. Accounting substitution tests target only temporal Evidence.coverage, and there are no controls for unread declarations or per-association occurrence substitution. Existing generic boundary tests cannot prove that this new wiring invokes the correct boundary and dependency checks.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Add missing/null/malformed/valid controls for the new role plumbing and isolated declaration, dependency, applicability and occurrence guards. Assert literal subject/state/path/reason and denied support, and demonstrate that deleting each relevant guard fails its ordinary control on direct and retained paths. Do not defer these new-validator controls to A3 or d2.
